imgproxykit

A typed Python toolkit for building imgproxy URLs.

[![Tests Result](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/kondratevdev/imgproxykit/test.yml?branch=master&label=tests&labelColor=black&color=blue)](https://github.com/kondratevdev/imgproxykit/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![PyPI Version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/imgproxykit.svg?labelColor=black&color=blue)](https://pypi.org/project/imgproxykit/) [![PyPI Downloads](https://static.pepy.tech/personalized-badge/imgproxykit?period=total&units=INTERNATIONAL_SYSTEM&left_color=BLACK&right_color=BLUE&left_text=downloads)](https://pepy.tech/projects/imgproxykit) [![Supported Python Version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/imgproxykit.svg?labelColor=black&color=blue)](https://pypi.org/project/imgproxykit/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?labelColor=black)](LICENSE)
## Features - [x] Fully typed and checked with `mypy`, `pyright`, `ty` and `pyrefly` in strict modes - [x] Signed URLs using your `imgproxy` server's `key` and `salt` - [x] Immutable, reusable transforms combining typed options and scalar arguments - [x] Variants: generate multiple image URLs from a reusable set of transforms - [x] Support for named presets configured on your `imgproxy` server - [x] Native `Django` integration with settings, shortcuts, and template tags - [x] Native `Django REST Framework` integration with serializers - [x] Native `FastAPI` integration with dependency injection --------- ## Installation Requires **Python 3.12+** and a running [imgproxy](https://github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy) server. ```bash pip install imgproxykit ``` There are several included extras: - `'imgproxykit[django]'` provides [Django integration](https://imgproxykit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/integrations/django.html) with settings, shortcuts, and template tags - `'imgproxykit[drf]'` provides [Django REST Framework integration](https://imgproxykit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/integrations/drf.html) with serializer fields for image URLs and named variants - `'imgproxykit[fastapi]'` provides [FastAPI integration](https://imgproxykit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/integrations/fastapi.html) with client registration and dependency injection ## Examples ### Single URL Build a URL for a cropped `webp` thumbnail: ```python >>> from imgproxykit import Client, Transform >>> from imgproxykit.options import Resize >>> # Public URL of your imgproxy server. >>> client = Client('https://imgproxy.example.com') >>> thumbnail = Transform( ... Resize(width=300, height=300, mode='fill'), # Pass typed option objects. ... quality=80, # Or scalar keywords, equivalent to Quality(80). ... format='webp', ... ) >>> source_url = 'https://originals.example.com/products/backpack.jpg' >>> thumbnail_url = client.url(source=source_url, transform=thumbnail) ``` The generated URL has this structure, with the source URL encoded as URL-safe Base64: ```text https://imgproxy.example.com/unsafe/resize:fill:300:300/quality:80/format:webp/ ``` `thumbnail_url` points to a 300×300 `webp` thumbnail cropped to fill the dimensions. Imgproxy fetches and processes the original image when this URL is requested. ### Variants Build variants by combining shared transforms with different settings: ```python >>> from imgproxykit import Client, Transform >>> client = Client('https://imgproxy.example.com') >>> # Share quality and output format across all variants. >>> base = Transform(quality=85, format='webp') >>> products = { ... 'small': Transform(*base.options, width=320), ... 'medium': Transform(*base.options, width=640), ...
